history_cleanup_confirm_text: %s datapoints with %s values (%s) will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
history_cleanup_confirm_title: Delete data of datapoints that are no longer logged?
history_cleanup_disabled_warning: These states still exist - their history is only unreachable because logging is switched off. Deleting it cannot be undone.
history_cleanup_failed: %s datapoints could not be removed completely, see the log
history_cleanup_nothing: There is nothing to clean up.

history_confirm_delete_one: Delete the entry from %s? This cannot be undone.
history_entry_not_found: The entry was not found. It may have been changed or deleted in the meantime.
history_include_disabled: Also those with logging switched off
history_instance_not_alive: The instance is not running. Start it to see the stored values.
history_no_data: No values stored for this datapoint
history_no_datapoints: No datapoint with stored values found yet
history_select_datapoint: Select a datapoint on the left to see its stored values
history_stats_hint: Every file is read to count its values, which can take a while with a lot of data - choose a shorter period to speed it up. The size is the exact size of the files on the disk.
history_stats_not_running: The instance is not running, so no statistics can be read
history_truncated: Too many entries to count them all - only the newest ones are shown. Narrow the time range.
